scope: post-hoc mechanism checks on development evidence; no model admission

fixed_prior_diagnostic.rule: multiply each non-Home probability by (outer_training_Casual_count / outer_training_class_count)^0.25 and renormalize the full nine-vector
fixed_prior_diagnostic.home: leave Home multiplier equal to one
fixed_prior_diagnostic.tuning: none; one fixed exponent; no threshold grid
fixed_prior_diagnostic.interpretation: decision-boundary sensitivity, not proof of a calibrated or deployable improvement

pixel_checks.all_development: decoded RGB hash and dimensions only
pixel_checks.image_previews: teacher images from canonical folds 1,2,3 only
pixel_checks.external_previews: same-ID local external pixels only for those preselected training IDs; do not open external labels
pixel_checks.external_inventory: filename IDs only; count overlaps against canonical split and prediction-manifest IDs; no extra split
